scripts.name: AccuLynx Send
scripts.description: Terros to AccuLynx. Install once per AccuLynx location, with that location's API key.

configSchema.name: recordType
configSchema.description: Required, no default. 'contact' creates an AccuLynx contact; 'job' creates a contact and a job for it. The new ID is saved as the account's externalLeadId and the account is not sent again.

configSchema.name: contactTypeId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx contact type ID for new contacts.

configSchema.name: leadSourceId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx lead source ID for new jobs.

configSchema.name: accountFilterField
configSchema.description: Optional. Dotted Terros account field, such as workflowState.workflowId, that decides which AccuLynx location an account belongs to. Blank sends every account.

configSchema.name: accountFilterValues
configSchema.description: Comma-separated values of accountFilterField that this install (this location) sends.

configSchema.name: addressCountry
configSchema.description: Optional. Two-letter country code (such as US or CA) of this location's job addresses. Terros addresses carry no country and AccuLynx needs one, so without it jobs are created with no address.

authSchema.apiKey: AccuLynx API key for one location (Account Settings > API Keys)

scripts.name: AccuLynx Webhook
scripts.description: AccuLynx to Terros. Subscribe this URL to the job.milestone.current_changed topic for one AccuLynx location.

configSchema.name: workflowId
configSchema.description: Required. Terros workflow ID (WF.*) whose stage is set from the AccuLynx milestone name

configSchema.name: requestType
configSchema.description: Required, no default. 'update' moves only accounts linked to the job by AccuLynx Send; 'upsert' also creates an account for a job started in AccuLynx.

configSchema.name: subscriptionId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx webhook subscription ID of this location. Events naming any other subscription are refused. This routes events between locations; it is not authentication.

configSchema.name: accountSource
configSchema.description: Terros accountSource to record on the account (defaults to 'AccuLynx')

authSchema.apiKey: AccuLynx API key for the same location (Account Settings > API Keys)
